description: Build Designer configuration UIs: Promoted Alternatives, Consultant Permissions, and Hidden Components panels with dialogs
steps: Create src/components/PromotedAlternatives/PromotedAlternativesPanel.tsx - Panel showing promoted alternative SKUs per zone. Lists zones with their promoted alternatives. Each alternative shows SKU code, product type, and a remove button. Includes 'Add Alternative' button that opens the dialog. Only visible in DESIGNER mode. Uses fromTable('template_zone_alternative') to fetch data. data-testid='promoted-alternatives-panel'.

Create src/components/PromotedAlternatives/AddAlternativeDialog.tsx - Dialog to browse and select alternative SKUs for a zone. Shows a simple SKU list (from skuStore or direct query to sku_master). Has zone selector, SKU search/select, and confirm/cancel buttons. On confirm, inserts into template_zone_alternative table. data-testid='add-alternative-dialog'.

Create src/components/ConsultantPermissions/ConsultantPermissionsPanel.tsx - Panel showing per-template consultant permissions. Lists existing permissions with parameter_name, permission_type (LOCKED, RANGE, SELECTION), and constraints. Includes 'Add Permission' button. Only visible in DESIGNER mode. Uses fromTable('template_consultant_permission'). data-testid='consultant-permissions-panel'.

Create src/components/ConsultantPermissions/AddPermissionDialog.tsx - Dialog with controlled vocabulary: parameter_name dropdown (from known parameters like zone_width, zone_height, sku_selection, quantity), permission_type selector (LOCKED/RANGE/SELECTION), constraint fields (min_value, max_value for RANGE; allowed_values[] for SELECTION). On confirm, inserts into template_consultant_permission. data-testid='add-permission-dialog'.

Create src/components/HiddenComponents/HiddenComponentsPanel.tsx - Panel listing hidden components for the template. Shows component name, trigger type (ALWAYS/CONDITION/DEPENDENCY), quantity rule, and condition details. Includes 'Add Hidden Component' button. Only visible in DESIGNER mode. Uses fromTable('template_hidden_component'). data-testid='hidden-components-panel'.

Create src/components/HiddenComponents/AddHiddenComponentDialog.tsx - Dialog to define a hidden component: SKU selector, trigger type dropdown (ALWAYS/CONDITION/DEPENDENCY), condition fields (field, operator, value - shown when CONDITION selected), quantity rule dropdown (FIXED/PER_ZONE/PER_PANEL/DERIVED_FROM_PARENT), fixed value input. On confirm, inserts into template_hidden_component. data-testid='add-hidden-component-dialog'.

Create src/components/PromotedAlternatives/__tests__/PromotedAlternativesPanel.test.tsx - Test rendering with mocked alternatives data, add button visibility in DESIGNER mode, removal of alternatives.
Create src/components/ConsultantPermissions/__tests__/ConsultantPermissionsPanel.test.tsx - Test rendering with mocked permissions, add button opens dialog, permission types display correctly.
Create src/components/HiddenComponents/__tests__/HiddenComponentsPanel.test.tsx - Test rendering with mocked hidden components, trigger type display, add button works.
acceptance_criteria: PromotedAlternativesPanel renders zone alternatives from template_zone_alternative and supports add/remove
AddAlternativeDialog allows SKU selection and persists to template_zone_alternative
ConsultantPermissionsPanel renders permissions with controlled vocabulary and supports add
AddPermissionDialog provides LOCKED/RANGE/SELECTION types with appropriate constraint fields
HiddenComponentsPanel renders hidden components with trigger types and supports add
AddHiddenComponentDialog provides ALWAYS/CONDITION/DEPENDENCY triggers with condition fields
verification: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run
findings: All 643 tests pass (28 new + 615 existing). TypeScript strict mode passes. React act() warnings are informational only and consistent with existing test patterns in the project.
